name: firecrawl
description: Knowledge infrastructure to make your agents smarter. Search, scrape and access 550+ data providers through one API.
one_liner: A service that turns any website into clean, structured data an AI program can read, so you don't have to write and maintain custom scraping code for every site.
buyer: A startup founder building an AI product — a research tool, price tracker, or lead-gen tool — who needs reliable web data without building and babysitting scrapers.
business_use_cases: A sales-intelligence startup uses it to pull fresh company data from hundreds of websites to feed its lead database.
A price-comparison or deal-tracking site monitors competitor pricing pages without brittle custom scrapers breaking every month.
An AI research assistant product uses it as its 'read the live web' backend so the agent can cite and summarize current pages.

money_ideas.idea: Build a niche vertical product on top (e.g. a restaurant menu tracker or competitor pricing monitor) and charge businesses a subscription for the curated output.
Resell scraping-as-a-service with a markup to smaller developers who don't want to manage API keys or infrastructure themselves.

steal_this: Build a 'watch this page, tell me when it changes' alert tool for one specific niche (permit filings, competitor pricing) this weekend and charge a monthly fee.
